# UE4SS runtime

UE4SS_v3.0.1-1176-g1ba38db4.zip is the unchanged upstream UE4SS experimental build used to validate this launcher. Its original experimental-latest asset was replaced upstream. This copy prevents installed launchers from relying on that moving URL.

SHA256: e615ee7a2c24344ea5aeef85183d6cfd550f4f6352225976679f9fefffd0b9a5

Upstream: https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS
Source revision: https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/tree/1ba38db4
License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 Narknon; the upstream license remains inside the archive at ue4ss/LICENSE and is installed with the runtime.

No new UE4SS build is silently substituted. Both bundled and fallback downloads must pass the pinned SHA256 check.
